title: The North Face Double Headed Toad 44 BX review: a light family tent for summer
dek: A four-pole, four-person tent at 7 lb 9 oz trail weight. Owners say it fits two adults and two kids, pitches in minutes and handles hard rain.
subject: The North Face Double Headed Toad 44 BX
verdict: The Double Headed Toad 44 BX is a light four-person tent that owners say fits two adults and two kids, goes up in minutes and holds up in hard rain and wind. Its odd shape and big footprint don't suit every backcountry tent pad, and it's a summer tent, not a snow tent.
bestFor: Families with young kids, short backpacking trips and summer car camping.
notFor: Snow, or backcountry sites with small tent platforms.

body:
## The short version

The Double Headed Toad 44 BX is a four-person, four-pole tent with 9 mm poles and a 54-square-foot floor. It was part of The North Face's 2011 line. Owners on Trailspace describe it as a light, easy family tent.

## Space

Owners say it's roomy enough for two adults and two kids, and light enough to carry on short trips.

## Setup

Setup is quick and easy. One family says their kids can pitch it in a couple of minutes.

## Weather

Several owners report it handled hard rain and wind well, and one says condensation isn't an issue. Owners describe it as best for summer; one notes it's not suited to snow.

## Watch out for

Its footprint can be too big for some backcountry tent platforms, and one owner calls the shape odd. Check the platform sizes where you camp.

## Poles and parts

The Double Headed Toad 44 BX uses **4 poles**, **9 mm** tubing.

The North Face doesn't publish pole lengths. To match a replacement, lay your pole out straight, measure tip to tip, count the sections, and read the diameter printed near a joint (or use calipers). Then search the Double Headed Toad 44 BX in our [pole and parts finder](/poles?model=Double%20Headed%20Toad%2044%20BX), compare against measured stock in the [pole size chart](/poles/sizes), or search by measurement in [find a pole by size](/poles/size).

## Bottom line

For a family with young kids, a used Double Headed Toad is a light, quick, weather-capable summer tent.
